newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH FIRM ZREW SEES 1997 NET UP TO PLN 2.8 MLN.
newsitem.headline: POLISH FIRM ZREW SEES 1997 NET UP TO PLN 2.8 MLN.

text.p: Polish power equipment repairer ZREW SA expects to lift net profit to 2.8 million zlotys this year from 2.5 million in 1996, the firm said in an abbreviated version of its issue prospectus.

ZREW, which does not plan to conduct an initial public offering and seeks to enter the Warsaw bourse's parallel market in April, said sales would increase to 65 million zlotys this year from 60 million in 1996.
ZREW, whose full name is Zaklady Remontowe Energetyki Warszawa SA, has had all its 868,120 shares cleared for public trade.
Its largest shareholder is the state treasury, which has 12.9 percent of shares.
